name: request_inspector

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run frontend:install && npm run backend:install
scripts.backend:install: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm --prefix frontend run type-check

author: Faiku
description: Catch and inspect HTTP requests and webhooks in a private, password-protected inbox.
